senses.gloss: naikhanya, in tripauruṣa-naikhanyāni (iṣikāni, or iṣī˚) Mv 〔i.196.2〕; 〔iii.228.13〕, (having) a part sunk in the earth (measuring three man-lengths). Mss. naikhadya or nakhanya; Senart on 〔i.196.2〕 reads naikhānya, but in his note adopts ˚kha˚ from the parallel; however, naikhānya may be right, for the word is clearly the same as that cited by BR from Ṣaḍv. Br. 〔4.4〕 yūpasya yan naikhānyam.
